tldr: Global markets saw a slight downturn as investors reacted to ongoing geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainties.
Ukraine launched a significant drone attack on Russia, hitting a warehouse near Moscow and causing casualties.
Record numbers of sea turtle nests were observed in Florida, though environmental protections face potential rollbacks.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower as markets digested a mix of geopolitical risks and consumer spending data, with upcoming earnings reports from major retailers like Walmart and Target expected to offer further insight into the health of the U.S. consumer amidst persistent inflation.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose, reflecting ongoing concerns about inflation and the potential for continued interest rate hikes.

vix.why: The VIX saw a slight decrease, suggesting a marginal reduction in market volatility despite the mixed economic signals and geopolitical events.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Researchers are exploring the implications of large language models (LLMs) trained on limited, lower-grade educational material, questioning their potential and limitations compared to models with broader training data.

Anthropic reported a significant jump in revenue to over $11.5 billion in the second quarter, highlighting the rapid growth of AI companies and their preparations for potential initial public offerings.

The growing threat of wildfire smoke to prenatal health is now greater than human-caused air pollution, according to new research that indicates a reversal of progress in air quality for expectant mothers.

world.summary: Ukraine launched one of its largest drone attacks of the war, hitting a distribution warehouse near Moscow and resulting in at least six fatalities, according to Russian authorities.
Israel has transferred West Bank policing to civilian forces, a move described as cementing de facto annexation and empowering settler militias, despite ongoing ceasefire concerns.
Twelve people died and ten more were seriously injured when a bus carrying Polish pilgrims overturned on a motorway in Hungary.

weekly_recap: This past week was marked by persistent geopolitical tensions, including continued Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon and escalating Russian attacks in Ukraine, alongside significant Ukrainian drone strikes deep into Russia. Economic indicators showed a slight easing of inflation, but consumer spending health remains a key focus ahead of major retail earnings. Extreme weather events, such as wildfires in Europe and floods in Japan, continued to impact global regions. Looking ahead, markets will be closely watching corporate earnings reports and any further developments in the ongoing international conflicts.
